title_zh: 了解成人阅读小组并约好首次接待

scenario.label_zh: 了解成人阅读小组并约好首次接待
scenario.goal_zh: 说明学习读写与减少孤立感的需要，核对图书馆支持，并约定先到接待台了解小组

context_zh: 虚构社区图书馆接待对话。成年访客希望改善读写能力，也想认识其他学习者。
author: author-phase11-b

sentences.speaker: Walter
sentences.text: Improving my literacy has been a lifelong goal, but I've always been embarrassed to join a class.

sentences.speaker: Farah
sentences.text: Our reading group is small, and no one has to read aloud on their first visit.

sentences.speaker: Walter
sentences.text: That helps. Since I stopped working, the isolation has been hard as well.

sentences.speaker: Farah
sentences.text: There's time to talk over tea before each session. You can get to know people without having to perform.

sentences.speaker: Walter
sentences.text: Is the group part of the library, or does someone just rent a room here?

sentences.speaker: Farah
sentences.text: The library provides the room and trained tutors. That institutional support means the group doesn't depend on one volunteer being available.

sentences.speaker: Walter
sentences.text: Could I come to the desk first and ask a few questions before joining the session?

sentences.speaker: Farah
sentences.text: Of course. Come at ten on Thursday and ask for me.

sentences.speaker: Walter
sentences.text: Thursday at ten. I'll start with that conversation.

targets.sense_zh: 机构提供的、机构层面的
